- **Background work, rebuilt:** Resume really resumes, imports no longer stall after a failed or cancelled file check, more jobs run at once (see the new Jobs running at once setting), and Recent work shows plain progress for each run. The update clears out old job history and can take a few minutes on large libraries, so back up first.
- **Lock an album:** in an album's Options, the owner can turn on Lock album. Your items in it go into Locked, with the rest of their stacks and Live Photo videos, and so does anything of yours added later. Other members' items and links stay as they are. Turning it off stops new items locking and leaves locked items locked.
- **Faster uploads:** large files upload in several parts at once, with no per-file size limit, and use bigger parts on Wi-Fi.
- **Database update:** Frameleaf moves to PostgreSQL 19 RC 1. Update Frameleaf Manager to 1.2.6 first; it copies your database to PostgreSQL 19 RC 1 during the Frameleaf update and keeps the old copy until it succeeds. Plain Docker Compose installs: follow "Moving to a new PostgreSQL build" in the Postgres administration docs before starting the new release.
- **Troubleshooting in Manager:** the Services page has a new Troubleshooting card. Check connections tests Docker, the database, machine learning, network discovery, the internet, your server's clock and free space, and says plainly what's wrong. Download report saves one file with the problems Manager spotted and recent logs from every part of Frameleaf (up to 1,000 lines each from the last 24 hours). Manager takes out passwords, folder paths, file names and e-mail addresses as best it can: read the report and remove anything private before you attach it to a post in Community › Bug reports.
- **Complete logs:** the service logs in Manager now include the error output Frameleaf's services print, so database messages no longer go missing.
- **Your computers in one place:** the Computers page now shows the Frameleaf Desktop helpers on your other computers.
- **Smoother imports:** resuming an import after Frameleaf has started no longer checks your original app again.
- **Security updates:** updated components with known security fixes.
